Spoiler[close]vanilla starsector has total of 50 ability slots, spread across 5 toolbars... this mod allows you to use ALL of them, at the same time!

also features cached inputs, so if you, for example, press "4" and "3" on keyboard within 0.5s of each other, it will activate ability in slot 43

beyond that, should work the same as normal and make no changes to the actual functionality of abilities.

aiDescription: Expands the number of usable ability slots beyond the vanilla limit of 50, allowing all slots to be active simultaneously. Adds cached input functionality so that sequential key presses like '4' and '3' within half a second activate ability slot 43. Makes no changes to the actual behavior of abilities, only improves access and input handling.
